explication: MateClaw is a multi-surface, Spring Boot agent product: users interact through the web console, desktop, embedded webchat, or messaging channels; server-side agents run turns, use configured models and tools, and produce conversation and knowledge results. The README documents native and DSH runtimes, durable Goals, Team Runs, approvals, memory, Wiki, and integrations. Source excerpts are selective, so unsampled subsystem links below rely only on those README descriptions; this is a product map, not a complete call graph.
